message.content: In one of the messages, JenniferMoore suggests a gradual increase in weight by suggesting that Li Hua “make sure to warm up properly” and “gradually increase the reps and sets each week to ensure you're building strength.” This advice indicates that JenniferMoore recommends a methodical approach to increasing the weight on the bench press, emphasizing the importance of proper preparation and a steady progression rather than sudden jumps in weight. Specifically, she mentions focusing on “gradually increasing the reps and sets,” which is a common strategy used in resistance training to allow the body time to adapt and avoid injury.
